    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The tree is a tree with groups; every agent is a treeitem labelled with its name and status, aria-expanded on branches
      - listitem: Fold buttons name what they do, e.g. "Show 2 sub-agents of Researcher"
      - listitem: "\"needs you\" and \"failed\" are buttons with aria-expanded; their window is a dialog, the first answer is focused and Esc closes it"
      - listitem: The totals in the bar – agents, running, needs you, failed, cost – are announced politely when they change
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A new agent's connector draws itself from the parent's dot, then the card rises in; several new agents rise one after another
      - listitem: When the tree changes, every card glides to its new place and the connectors follow frame by frame
      - listitem: Agents that leave – a folded branch, removed data – fade out a beat apart, bottom first, while their connectors pull back into the parent
      - listitem: "Status glyphs: a spinning loader while running, a check when done, a warning triangle when failed, a clock when it needs you"
      - listitem: Costs that still climb – a running agent, a branch with one, the total – carry a light shimmer that runs over the amount
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: From 560px the first level sits side by side under the root, deeper levels hang below their parent – every card has the same width
      - listitem: Narrower, every level is indented under its parent and the connectors run down the left; the cards shrink together so the deepest level still fits
      - listitem: The connectors are measured from the cards, so any width or zoom works
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the whole tree every time something changes – ids keep the cards in place, new ids grow in with a drawn connector
      - listitem: cost is the agent's own spend; the component adds the children up, so don't pre-sum it
      - listitem: A failed agent that gets retried is a new child with its own id – keep the failed one, it tells the story
      - listitem: The connector color is --ui-agtc-link (#82bcff), the soft blue of the Project Flow illustration
      - listitem: The chevron is Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
